name: Corporate Action Price 99
definition: Specifies prices related to a corporate action option.

GenericCashPriceReceivedPerProduct.name: Generic Cash Price Received Per Product
GenericCashPriceReceivedPerProduct.definition: Generic cash price received per product by the underlying security holder either as a percentage or an amount, for example, redemption price.

GenericCashPricePaidPerProduct.name: Generic Cash Price Paid Per Product
GenericCashPricePaidPerProduct.definition: Generic cash price paid per product by the underlying security holder either as a percentage or an amount, for example, reinvestment price.

GenericCashPricePerProductGuideline.definition: Generic Cash Price Received per Product (OFFR) and Generic Cash Price Paid per Product (PRPP) are prices received or paid in the course of an event. The specific meaning (redemption price, subscription price, reinvestment price, etc.) is derived from the event type.
